records.name: Personal AI Memory V2
records.tagline: Captures and stores your AI Conversation from LLM platforms
records.description: AI Memory is a privacy-first browser extension that captures, organizes, and lets you seamlessly recall your ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and Claude conversations locally without data leaks.

records.name: MobileScreen
records.tagline: Design App Store screenshots in your IDE
records.description: MobileScreen is an AI agent for App Store screenshots. Just take raw screenshots of your app in the simulator and MobileScreen turns them into polished, ASO-optimized App Store screenshots for all device sizes. It can also upload them directly to App Store Connect. With the CLI tool, developers and coding agents like Claude Code can generate, update, and upload screenshots automatically as part of their workflow—making screenshot creation fully automated.

records.name: NeuralAgent
records.tagline: Personal AI Assistant that operates your entire computer
records.description: NeuralAgent operates your entire computer — it sees your screen, opens apps, clicks buttons, and manages files like you would. With Skills, it gains infinite capabilities: connecting to Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, Slack, Notion, and 30+ services through API, UI, and CLI. Just tell it what you want in plain English.

records.name: ClawsList
records.tagline: Craigslist for the agent economy - where AI and humans trade
records.description: The marketplace where AI agents and humans trade services. Post listings, hire agents, trade compute, and build the agent economy.

records.name: Runner AI
records.tagline: Build, optimize, and scale your AI-native store
records.description: Don't just prompt a website; prompt revenue. Runner AI builds AND optimizes. It continuously runs experiments in the background, automatically turning visitors into buyers.

records.name: Retell
records.tagline: Watch it Once. Retell it Forever.
records.description: Retell turns any YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, or Instagram video into 40+ formats with one click. Paste a link, get social posts, whiteboards, infographics, cheat sheets, AI podcasts, handwritten notes, comic strips, newsletters, and more. No other tool produces visual outputs like whiteboards and infographics directly from a video URL. No competitor supports all 4 platforms. Most tools give you text summaries. Retell gives you an entire content library. Free to try, no account required.

records.name: Keak
records.tagline: Agent that improves your website 24/7
records.description: Keak generates variations 24/7, tests them, and auto-promotes the winner. No engineers, no guesswork. Trained on thousands of successful CRO experiments. Now extended to AI agents with Keak Agents.

records.name: Astrio
records.tagline: Modernize your outdated websites in minutes, not weeks
records.description: Astrio is an AI agent that modernizes existing websites. Import from anywhere and transform old tech stacks into modern, editable websites in minutes.

records.name: Sutra
records.tagline: Engineering change on autopilot
records.description: Manufacturing engineers spend hours pushing changes through PLM systems. Not engineering. Just hunting part numbers, checking BOMs, pulling cost data, and formatting ECRs. Sutra runs engineering change on autopilot. Describe the problem and Sutra makes the change decision, verifies parts, analyzes BOM impact, generates the change packet, and routes approvals automatically. What took hours now takes minutes.

records.name: ArtCraft
records.tagline: Cursor for film-Consistent control, virtual sets, BYOC, Open
records.description: ArtCraft is Cursor for film. It's designed by filmmakers and artists with features most AI image and video tools lack: control and consistency. Our 2D canvas and 3D stage enable fully precise articulation and blocking of scenes and get rid of random "dice rolling". ArtCraft has full intentionality and repeatability so you "craft" instead of prompt. ArtCraft is open source and lets you to bring your existing subscriptions. Finally, ArtCraft has the powerful Seedream 2.0 model before the US launch

records.name: A Bit Differently
records.tagline: This is Ava, a different kind of ChatGPT.
records.description: Since natural language has become the primary way we interact with all devices and apps, the entire UX should be changed. Menus, sidebars, and all traditional UI elements will no longer be necessary since you can simply ask for anything.

records.name: Timekeepur Labs
records.tagline: Agentic R&D factory to test pivots and benchmark strategy
records.description: Agentic R&D factory for builders that focuses on strategy before code. While most AI tools optimize coding or design, Timekeepur Labs helps founders plan launches, test pivots, and benchmark strategy against real market signals. Swarm agents analyze research, developer discourse from X, and evolving tech trends to generate grounded strategy maps and Cursor-ready build prompts.

records.name: Megaton Monitor
records.tagline: AI video benchmarks, leaderboards and industry news
records.description: Monitor is a comprehensive set of evaluations for video models aimed at creative teams looking at qualitative measures. Things such a visual fidelity, cinematography a well as industry specific metrics like copyright compliance and diversity measures. We aim to be the bloomberg of video ai!

records.name: Skayle
records.tagline: Rank in search. Get cited in AI.
records.description: Buyers are getting answers from ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI before they ever click a website. Skayle gives brands a connected, research-backed workflow to win visibility in AI search: track where you’re cited, recommended, or ignored, uncover competitor gaps, turn those insights into brand-aligned content designed to rank in search and earn citations, and publish it directly to your CMS.

records.name: Yap-It
records.tagline: Turn messy voice notes into ready-to-publish content.
records.description: Transform messy thoughts into polished, ready-to-publish content in one tap. Yap-It uses AI to instantly format your raw voice into viral tweets, engaging LinkedIn posts, professional emails, and structured notes

records.name: bugstack
records.tagline: Self-healing code
records.description: BugStack captures production errors, pulls context from your GitHub repo, generates minimal AI fixes, and deploys them autonomously. When an error hits, BugStack fetches the stack trace, imports, types, and tests. It generates a surgical fix, validates syntax, runs your CI pipeline, and either auto-merges or opens a PR for review. Open-source SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, and Go. One-click install via auto-generated PR. Set confidence thresholds per project. 14-day free trial.

records.name: Email API benchmarks
records.tagline: A real-time dashboard of email provider performance
records.description: Today we're releasing email API benchmarks, a real-time dashboard of email provider performance to help you compare and choose. The dashboard is powered by the billions of API requests Knock sends to downstream providers like SendGrid, Resend, Postmark, and more. We've aggregated this data to highlight important metrics (like response time and error rate) to help you compare email providers, not based on hype, but on their real-world performance data.

records.name: Pluck
records.tagline: Turn any web component into pixel-perfect AI Prompt
records.description: Pluck is a Chrome extension that lets you copy any UI component from any website and paste it into Claude, Cursor, Lovable, or any AI tool. One click captures the full structure — HTML, styles, fonts, colors, spacing, and assets. Paste and get pixel-perfect code.

records.name: BizBlock
records.tagline: The API for AI agents to book appointments
records.description: BizBlock is booking infrastructure for the AI era. We're live on Claude.ai as a remote MCP server. You can ask Claude to book an appointment at Salon Three One Four in St. Louis and it works end to end: search, availability, booking, payment, and confirmation. Service businesses sign up and get a dashboard to manage bookings. AI agents get a universal booking API. We're starting in St. Louis and building the standard booking layer for every AI assistant.

records.name: Coasty
records.tagline: Secure AI agents that work like humans but free & flawless
records.description: Coasty deploys AI employees on secure cloud VMs that work like humans browsing, clicking, typing across any app. #1 on OSWorld (82%). Handles CAPTCHAs, runs scheduled Routines, and covers 10+ departments. Full audit trail. Starts free. Deploy in 60 seconds.

records.name: Clawther
records.tagline: Give your OpenClaw agent a real task board
records.description: I accidentally connected my OpenClaw agent to Notion and realized something: Chat is the wrong interface for managing an agent. 👎 Agents need a task board, not a conversation. With a task board you can track multiple tasks in parallel and share the power with your team just like you would collaborate with a human teammate. ✅

records.name: muno
records.tagline: AI agents for PMs to automate check-ins and tasks
records.description: Create AI agents that conduct voice conversations with your team and complete follow up tasks for you.

records.name: Automated
records.tagline: Automate any workflow by recording a demo
records.description: Workflow automation for everyone; just record your workflow once and run it on autopilot forever. Automated spins up its own browser to complete your workflow, no integrations required.

records.name: Codex Chat
records.tagline: An open-source macOS client for Codex
records.description: Codex Chat is a Swift-native macOS client for Codex with local markdown memory, themes, mods, extensions, and optional phone remote control.

records.name: Flywheel.cx
records.tagline: AI churn prediction & prevention for SaaS
records.description: Flywheel.cx helps SaaS companies automatically prevent churn & upsell users. After running our previous startup for almost 3 years, we discovered that sticky revenue is what makes software valuable. We were adding $20k in new MRR each month, but losing just as much to churn. That's when retention became our focus, and Flywheel was born!

records.name: Outhop
records.tagline: The Vibe Selling Platform
records.description: Outhop finds you customers that want to buy your product RIGHT NOW, then sells your product to them. We gather signals from various online sources (social media, job boards, etc) to find customers who have IMMEDIATE INTENT TO BUY your product. Then we send them personalized emails to book you meetings.

records.name: UseDesktop
records.tagline: An infrastructure layer for training deskop agents
records.description: UseDesktop is an Infrastructure layer for training Deskop Agent. Desktop agent is a type of Computer use agent built to be more useful than the traditional Computer use agent by Anthropic, OpenAI and so on. It differs by combining the non-deterministic and deterministic features which then solves latency, accuracy, cost issues. At UseDesktop, you are able to train your own Desktop Agent, Create a model with your own data. It works just as expected creating real use cases unlike other agents.

records.name: Rovela
records.tagline: The first AI-native platform that builds your online store
records.description: Describe your business in a few sentences. Get a fully deployed online store in minutes. Products, checkout, payments, admin dashboard, hosting, all seamlessly integrated. Rovela doesn't use templates, our AI analyzes your business then generates a custom store on top of a battle-tested SDK. A $1M/year brand already migrated from Shopify. A $10M/year company left WordPress. A YC company chose us over building their own. No code, no plugins no developer. Just describe what you sell and launch!

records.name: Birdhouse
records.tagline: Open source IDE where AI agents coordinate as a team
records.description: Open source debut! Birdhouse is an agentic development environment built for multi-agent teams. Spin up agents that communicate directly with each other, organize into a live tree, and coordinate without you in the middle. Plus the quality-of-life stuff that other tools get wrong: agent navigation without losing your place, per-workspace API keys and models, and every VS Code theme you already use. MIT licensed, macOS, one install script.

records.name: Studio by HarnessGG
records.tagline: Vibe-edit videos locally using Codex
records.description: Harness Studio lets AI agents control desktop applications, Blender, GIMP, Kdenlive, and Electron apps through Codex. No MCP, no complex config. Agents self-install packages and start working. Studio is the visual interface that ties it all together, allowing you to edit videos in English.

records.name: Concipe
records.tagline: Turn customer feedback into specs for your coding agent
records.description: 84% of product teams worry their product won't succeed — yet feedback sits scattered across 15 tools. Concipe fixes that. Upload interviews and tickets, or connect Slack and Notion. AI extracts insights, ranks opportunities by evidence, and generates structured specs. Every recommendation traces to real user quotes. Connect via MCP and your coding agent pulls specs directly. Feedback to engineering-ready spec in under 10 minutes.

records.name: Signet
records.tagline: Autonomous AI wildfire agent with nearby alerts
records.description: Signet is an autonomous wildfire intelligence agent that monitors the continental US 24/7. It combines NASA satellite data, NOAA imagery and weather, fuel models, terrain, and exposure data to track incidents, generate outlooks, and predict fire behavior. The agent decides what to investigate, makes predictions, and verifies them against the next satellite pass. Sign up by ZIP code for free alerts when notable fire activity is detected nearby.

records.name: Pushary
records.tagline: Get push notifications when your AI agent finishes
records.description: Connect Pushary to Cursor, Claude, or Lovable via MCP. Get a push notification the moment your AI task completes. Stop tab-switching. Free for a month.

records.name: Huddle01 Cloud
records.tagline: Deploy your AI Agents in 60 seconds
records.description: Setting up OpenClaw shouldn't take hours. Deploy a fully managed & secure version of Openclaw in 60 seconds! We take care of infrastructure, AI inference & updates so you can focus on building your agents - not keeping them online. Train your agents, not your hosting skills.

records.name: Codirigent
records.tagline: Superset, Ghostty and tmux coding workspace but for Windows
records.description: The better Ghostty, Superset, and tmux experience for Windows (and MacOS). Codirigent puts all your sessions in one persistent workspace. - Real-time status per agent - Custom layouts - Git worktree support - Session resume with same permission states. - System notifications like MacOS do - Copy and paste image directly to your session - and more! Built in Rust with GPUI, ~40MB memory, 22MB on disk. Open Source GPL-3.0.

records.name: Donna AI
records.tagline: AI agents that find the right people to hire automatically
records.description: Hiring today runs on resumes and applications, which miss who people really are. Donna changes that. Every candidate and recruiter gets an AI agent that represents them, learns about them, and talks to other agents to discover strong matches. Instead of endless screening or applying, Donna introduces the right people automatically.

records.name: Sara
records.tagline: Project management without the project manager.
records.description: Sara is the first AI that doesn't help your PM - she is the PM. She connects to Jira, GitHub, Slack, and Confluence, builds a knowledge graph of your team, and autonomously detects blockers, nudges the right people, and keeps delivery on track. Not a dashboard. Not a chatbot. An AI teammate that does the job.

records.name: AI-powered Product Tour
records.tagline: Interactive product tours powered by AI
records.description: Told’s new AI-powered Product Tour helps product teams onboard users faster and drive activation from day one. Generate interactive tours in minutes, highlight key features inside your product, and guide users step by step — without code. Unlike traditional onboarding tools, Told combines product tours and in-app feedback in one platform, so you can guide users and learn from them at the same time.

records.name: Monostate
records.tagline: Vibe Training AI models
records.description: Monostate is an all-in-one AI training platform. Fine-tune LLMs with your own data using SFT, DPO, or RLHF — no training scripts required. Compare commercial and open-source models side by side with built-in benchmarking. Deploy to GPUs (A100s to H100s) with one click and autoscaling. Supports LoRA, QLoRA, and full parameter training across dozens of architectures. Works with Llama, Mistral, Phi, Qwen, and more. From data to production in minutes, not weeks.

records.name: TabDog
records.tagline: Manage all your browser tabs in one place
records.description: Most tab managers do one thing — save tabs or search tabs. TabDog does both, and more, in a single lightweight popup. Search all open tabs instantly. Group them by domain. Save any tab set as a color-coded workspace and restore it later. Reopen recently closed tabs. Navigate everything with your keyboard. Open source. Free. Works on Chrome, Brave, Edge, and all Chromium browsers.

records.name: HTML Pub
records.tagline: Turn AI-generated HTML into a live URL via MCP/API
records.description: Publish AI-generated HTML instantly via MCP. Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI tool can build and deploy a live URL without leaving the chat. Websites, landing pages, stores with checkout, blogs, portfolios, prototypes — live in seconds. Custom domains. Forms and integrations. Visual editor and AI editing. Analytics, conversions, and heatmaps. No repos. No deploy pipelines. No hosting config. Idea to live site, from your favourite AI.

records.name: Gauge
records.tagline: Your marketing agent for organic, paid, and AI search
records.description: Gauge is your marketing agent for organic, paid, and AI search. With user behavior now spread across traditional and AI search, it’s never been more important to ensure that your brand is the answer. There's a wealth of data hidden across GA4, GSC, keywords, prompts, and more. This data is incredibly rich, but fragmented and complicated to understand. Gauge unifies all of these data sources into a single agent that can do the work of an entire marketing team for you.

records.name: LaunchSafe
records.tagline: Autonomous Pentesting for Modern Applications
records.description: LaunchSafe is the autonomous offensive security company redefining pentesting for the AI era. Combining AI reasoning with real-world exploit chains, the LaunchSafe platform delivers continuous pentesting and automatic remediation at machine speed. LaunchSafe empowers engineering teams to ship fast without sacrificing security posture.

records.name: Clayzo
records.tagline: Prototype, design, and collaborate on your existing products
records.description: Clayzo lets product and design teams spin up their existing product, prototype directly on it, record walkthroughs, and leave contextual feedback tied to the real codebase. What used to live across screenshots, Looms, and Slack now becomes actionable tasks that engineers and coding agents can build from.

records.name: Russet
records.tagline: On-device AI that just works on Apple silicon
records.description: Russet elevates local AI to a 1st-party experience on Apple silicon. It combines Apple Intelligence and hardware-optimized MLX models with pre-configured tuning and simple interfaces like Flow which summarizes, translates, and debates input text. Agent tools sync with your calendar, contacts, and files, while Speech (Mac-only) lets you generate natural, expressive speech in custom voices. Like its namesake russet potato, Russet is the reliable and versatile AI staple you can always count on.

records.name: Covalent
records.tagline: AI for PMs that sees your screen & completes your work
records.description: Mac app that watches your screen and executes tasks automatically. Product managers constantly context-switch between Linear, Slack, docs, and customer calls. When they need AI, they have to manually copy context into a chat. Covalent watches your screen and builds a real-time knowledge graph to anticipate actions. Highlight “create ticket and notify eng,” and Covalent gathers context, creates the Jira ticket, and posts in Slack: no prompt needed.

records.name: Foil
records.tagline: An AI agent that monitors your AI agents
records.description: All observability tools simply log traces with no context. Foil reimagines how you deploy and maintain agents by learning your agents behavior and responsibilities. We call these agent profiles and they evolve as your agent runs. Hallucinations, behavioral drift, loops, grounding failures: caught automatically with context, not just logged. 🎁 Product Hunt Exclusive - 50% off Pro for 3 months with code FOILPH

records.name: OrangeLabs
records.tagline: Analyze, interpret, and create interactive visuals from data
records.description: OrangeLabs helps teams to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex data using AI. Upload/connect data, ask questions, and instantly get tables, charts, and insights. No formulas or code needed. Founders, analysts, and data teams use OrangeLabs AI agent to turn raw spreadsheets into clear decisions in seconds. Get started for free at: orangelabs.im

records.name: Agent Browser
records.tagline: Browser Agents that communicate using ASCII wireframes
records.description: Stop wasting tokens on screenshots. Agent Browser helps AI agents browse the web using wireframe snapshots rather than screenshots or DOM dumps.

records.name: Casero
records.tagline: A better legal memory for your law firm
records.description: Law firms are sitting on decades of winning work but every lawyer still starts from scratch. Casero turns a firm's existing cases, emails, and documents into a living knowledge graph. Every AI answer links back to the exact source passage. Closed cases become reusable precedent, matched by facts and legislation, not keywords. And the system flags blocked deadlines before they become problems. Most legal AI is a smarter search box. Casero is institutional memory.

records.name: Raccoon AI
records.tagline: A general purpose collaborative AI agent
records.description: Raccoon AI is a collaborative AI agent and workspace for getting real work done. You describe what you need and build it together with an AI agent that has its own computer, terminal, browser, and internet. You see every thought, every file it creates, every decision it makes. You steer when it drifts. You ship when it's right. Deploy web apps. Run deep research. Analyze data. Create pitch decks, videos, images, documents.

records.name: Clawcard
records.tagline: Give your agent a card, email and phone in one command
records.description: Clawcard is the first unified credential system for agents - one key provisions and manages credit cards, email, and a phone number. No cobbling together multiple services. No babysitting your agent through verification steps. When your agent needs to make a purchase, then verify via email or SMS, then manage an account, it can handle the entire flow without you intervening.

records.name: Coresignal Data Search
records.tagline: Build custom B2B lead lists in seconds with natural language
records.description: Coresignal's Data Search Lists lets you build B2B data lists using natural language and easily query multi-source company, employee, and jobs data. Just describe what you need, and our AI agent will generate a structured lead list you can preview, refine, and download instantly.

records.name: Whisker
records.tagline: Create and edit CAD models into production-ready prototypes
records.description: Whisker turns plain-English descriptions into production-ready parametric CAD models. A multi-agent AI pipeline generates real B-Rep geometry, verifies it using a proprietery algorithm, and iteratively fixes issues - all in under 1 minute. Every dimension is a tunable parameter. Export one-click to STEP, STL, or natively into Fusion 360 with full feature trees and linked user parameters. Real parametric CAD. Free to start.

records.name: Prava
records.tagline: Payments stack for AI agents
records.description: AI agents can browse, recommend, and decide, but they can't pay. Prava fixes that. We're the payments stack built for AI agents. Your AI can securely use a user's card or wallet to complete purchases. We've partnered with global card networks like Visa to power safe, seamless agentic payments. Live in production powering AI assistants, stylist apps, shopping agents, and more. Integrate in 4 lines of code. Today we're launching our Playground- even a non dev can experience the full flow

records.name: Aligno AI
records.tagline: Agents that gather feedback, scan code, & produce roadmaps
records.description: Aligno connects user feedback, roadmaps, and codebases in one system. Teams upload interviews, tickets, and Slack threads. Aligno then synthesizes themes, generates evidence-backed roadmaps, and connects directly to the codebase via MCP so AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code build with full product context. No guessing what to build.

records.name: RevFirma
records.tagline: Control which digital ads people see inside your property
records.description: Organizations secure buildings, networks, and data. The digital influence reaching people inside their physical locations is uncontrolled. RevFirma creates a digital perimeter that allows organizations to control the digital influence surrounding their property. We first tested the system in Carlton Landing, Oklahoma, absorbing 146,000+ external ad impressions targeting people inside the community. Every physical place has digital influence. RevFirma gives owners control of it.

records.name: PaperPod
records.tagline: On-demand sandboxes for AI Agents
records.description: PaperPod is a CLI based runtime for AI agents. We provide fast, no-setup sandbox where agents can run Python, JS/TS, start servers, expose public URLs, automate browsers, persist memory, etc. all via our CLI tool, no SDK setup or API keys required! It is a full linux environment with common tools preinstalled (git, bun, ffmpeg, pandoc, sqlite, etc.)

records.name: Basement Browser
records.tagline: A multiplayer mobile browser with AI agents on every webpage
records.description: Every mobile browser is a solo experience. Basement Browser turns every webpage into a live social room. Land on the same page as someone else and you're instantly connected. Then there's Baselings: AI agents that live in your browser, track prices, find better deals, monitor stock, and surface context you'd never think to search for. No extensions. No copy-pasting into ChatGPT. Your browser just works for you. Browse together. Shop smarter. Your phone's browser, finally upgraded.

records.name: Airpoint
records.tagline: Touchless computing with hand tracking and AI agents
records.description: Airpoint lets you control any computer with your hands without any extra hardware. Hand motion and gestures are translated in real time into cursor control, shortcuts, and app/games interactions. Built for anyone whose hands are busy or unavailable: crafters, gamers, builders, devs and more. Take advantage of VR/AR without headsets or extra hardware. The input layer also makes it possible for AI agents (OpenClaw) to autonomously control computers. SDK available to include in apps and games.

records.name: TokenZip
records.tagline: Open protocol for AI agents to share memory, not tokens
records.description: TokenZip Protocol reduces AI-to-AI communication bandwidth by 80% and latency by 95%. Open standard for heterogeneous agents. Try the live demo. Test API Base URL: https://tokenzip.org Auth: Authorization: Bearer demo-investor-key How to call it: See the following comment

records.name: ELU
records.tagline: Turn user drop-offs into Pull Requests
records.description: You can build an app in a weekend. But analytics? You installed PostHog, saw some charts, watched session recordings. Still no idea why users leave. Show ELU your flow. It reads your codebase, sets up tracking, and watches how users move through it. When someone drops off, ELU connects your analytics, code, and user data to find what went wrong, who's affected, and why. Then it ships a PR with the fix. Analytics tools were built for analysts. ELU was built for founders who ship.

records.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent
records.tagline: The video AI demo agent for B2B SaaS for immediate demos
records.description: Turn “Book a demo” into “Get an AI demo now.” Naoma is the first video AI demo agent for B2B SaaS that delivers live, personalized demos in-browser 24/7 in any language. It clicks through real product flows, answers questions, qualifies prospects, and routes them to CRM, sales calendar, or checkout. Choose the avatar style: human-like, branded mascot, or a more formal look to engage your prospects.

records.name: Agentipedia
records.tagline: Agents that experiment together to 100x any outcome
records.description: Post research hypotheses. AI agents submit structured experiment results. Knowledge compounds as runs build on each other. Based on Karpathy's Autoresearcher agent; Agentipedia allows for collaboration across agents. We can now build niche models in a crowdsourced way that solve thousands of specific use cases across the world, in culture, and in economy.

records.name: Needle 2.0
records.tagline: Vibe-automate workflows and earn passive income
records.description: Just tell our builder agent what needs to be automated. Watch it in real-time building, testing and shipping your workflow, hands-free. It’s 2026; just vibe-automate it. On top, we launched a new way to earn as an AI builder. Just submit your workflow and start earning.

records.name: oobo
records.tagline: Git layer that preserves the why behind AI-written code
records.description: Oobo is Git for agents (and humans). It enriches your repo with additional context about AI usage, helping agents and teams understand why something was built, how decisions were made, and what happened around the code, not just in the final diff.

records.name: Glass
records.tagline: Continuous Improvement for your AI Agent
records.description: Glass turns AI anomalies into automated improvements through an infinite feedback loop that detects misbehaviors and feeds them into continuous evaluations to refine your agent.

records.name: Tycono
records.tagline: Platform that turns multi-agent AI into a game-like visual
records.description: One order. Hundreds of AI agents plan, build, and learn together — sharing knowledge that compounds with every task. It looks like a tycoon game: pixel-art office, agents at desks, leveling up. But they do real work — CEO dispatches orders through the org tree, each role has scoped authority, and knowledge grows every session. Company-as-Code: roles and workflows in YAML/Markdown. Versionable, forkable — like IaC for organizations. npx tycono — one command. Local-first, BYOK, open-source.

records.name: Noah AI
records.tagline: Build crypto apps by chatting with AI
records.description: Noah AI lets anyone build and deploy complete crypto applications using plain English instead of writing code. Describe what you want and Noah generates the UI, onchain programs, and infrastructure needed to run the app. It also lets users spin up OpenClaw agents with their own wallets and built-in custom skills to interact with onchain protocols. Noah is how the next generation of Crypto apps gets built.

records.name: AskNeo
records.tagline: End-to-end Voice & SMS shared inbox for Teams
records.description: We are launching an entire new version of the shared inbox with an all-new end-to-end voice system on top of the text messaging suite! AskNeo now centralizes texts, calls, and contacts all in one place. The simple dashboard helps you track every interaction in a single thread per customer. Sales, marketing, customer support, and any department maintain perfect continuity and collaborate asynchronously across teams. One single thread to deliver the best results every time!

records.name: Fort
records.tagline: Fort tracks strength for people who care about longevity.
records.description: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.

records.name: LOVE
records.tagline: Bulk download or export your entire Vimeo library
records.description: Vimeo is about to raise prices. This is the escape tool. Bulk download or export your entire library, folders, and metadata to Livid or Google Drive for free. Breaking up with Vimeo is hard; L.O.V.E. makes it easy.

records.name: How Rare Are You?
records.tagline: Find out how statistically rare you are!
records.description: howrareami.org calculates your statistical rarity across 5 categories: Body & Traits, Biology & Genetics, Personality, Life Experiences, and Career & Education. Every question maps to a real-world statistic from peer-reviewed research. Multiply your probabilities together and find out exactly how rare your specific combination is among 8 billion people. Free, no paywall, takes about 3 minutes per category. 50,000 quizzes taken in the first 3 days.

records.name: Coinexra
records.tagline: Engineering the future of digital finance with blockchain
records.description: Coinexra delivers innovative white label digital banking solutions, enabling banks, fintechs, and startups to launch secure, next-gen financial platforms.

records.name: AstraZ AI

records.description: ReteFigo is a network monitoring and diagnostic toolkit that helps you understand what's happening with your internet connection. 🚀 Speed Testing - See your real speeds, not what your ISP claims 📊 Bufferbloat Detection - Find the hidden cause of gaming lag and video call freezing 🎮 Gaming Diagnostics - Test ping to Minecraft, Valorant, CS2, and more 🗺️ Network Topology - See every device on your network 📝 ISP Complaint Generator - Build evidence-backed reports with pre-written rebuttals

records.name: Quantistic
records.tagline: Catch PE fee overcharges before they cost you millions
records.description: Are your GPs charging you correctly? SEC actions against Apollo, KKR, and others have clawed back $140M+ in LP fee overcharges. Quantistic extracts your LPA fee terms and verifies them against GP quarterly reports, flagging discrepancies with evidence. No spreadsheets, no manual review. Built for family offices, fund-of-funds, and LP advisory firms.

records.name: PDF BOSS
records.tagline: Free PDF tools -merge, compress, split. No sign-up.100% free
records.description: PDF Boss is a free online PDF toolkit —no account, no watermark, no subscription. Ever. 🔧 Tools: -Compress PDF —Reduce size by 80% -Merge PDF —Combine unlimited files -Split PDF —Extract any pages -PDF to Word —Editable DOCX output -Word to PDF —Perfect formatting -Rotate PDF —Fix sideways pages -Excel to PDF —Spreadsheet conversion ✅ 100% Free —No hidden charges ✅ No Sign-Up Required ✅ No Watermark Added ✅ Files deleted within 1 hour ✅ Works on Android & iPhone Try it free at pdfboss.in 🚀

records.name: WowWishes
records.tagline: Create a beautiful digital birthday surprise in minutes 🎉
records.description: WowWishes helps you create a beautiful digital birthday surprise in minutes. Instead of sending a simple “Happy Birthday” message, create a personalized page filled with photos, videos, and heartfelt wishes from friends and family. Share the link or QR code and give someone a birthday surprise they’ll never forget. 🎉

records.name: DataMorph
records.tagline: Convert, format, and generate data securely in your browser.
records.description: What makes DataMorph stand out? 🔒 Zero-Server Privacy: Everything happens client-side. Your data never leaves your browser, making it completely safe for proprietary code, API keys, and PII. ⚡ Lightning Fast: Because there are no server round-trips, conversions and formatting happen instantly as you type. ✨ Developer-First UX: A clean, distraction-free interface with a beautiful Dark Mode, syntax highlighting, and keyboard-friendly design. No pop-ups, no paywalls, no ads.

records.name: Lingovox
records.tagline: Voice-to-voice translator inside Telegram
records.description: Lingovox is a Telegram bot that translates voice messages into other languages and sends the translation back as voice. Just send a voice message, choose the target language, and receive the translated audio instantly. Perfect for: • international teams • travelers • language learners • communicating across languages in chats No apps to install — everything works directly inside Telegram. Voice → AI translation → voice output.

records.name: HashProof
records.tagline: API for Verifiable Credentials
records.description: HashProof is an API that lets developers and AI agents issue verifiable credentials instead of PDFs. Most certificate tools are SaaS platforms. HashProof takes a different approach: a simple API with pay-per-use pricing. Each credential costs 0.10 USDC using x402, with metadata stored on IPFS and a hash registered on the blockchain for public verification. Developers can create templates, place dynamic values on designs, and define expiration dates for memberships or permanent credentials.

records.name: Linklify
records.tagline: The free link-in-bio with a store, blog & analytics built in
records.description: Linklify is a free all-in-one creator tool. Get a beautiful link-in-bio page, URL shortener, click analytics, creator store, leads form, built-in blog, and Amazon affiliate link cleaner — all in one place. No credit card needed. Free forever plan, Pro at $5/mo.

records.name: HR Connect
records.tagline: Smart HRMS for payroll, attendance & AI hiring
records.description: HR Connect makes HR simple. Handle payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment, and more—all from one smart platform. Automate repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and keep your team connected and productive without the hassle. Designed for growing businesses, HR Connect centralizes HR processes and integrates seamlessly with Sitedecode’s all-in-one ecosystem. Focus on what really matters: your people and business growth.

records.name: POGO: Jump Higher
records.tagline: The vertical jump program that gets you dunking.
records.description: POGO is a vertical jump training app with a 12-week program, in-app workouts, progress tracking, and AI coaching from Sparky. Athletes can track vertical, weight, 40-yard, and broad jump, while coaches can manage rosters, assign workouts, and log athlete metrics in one place. Free to start.

records.name: Pulse
records.tagline: Your AI co-founder that remembers everything
records.description: Pulse is a RAG-powered personal intelligence layer for founders. Paste your LinkedIn, GitHub, and a self-report once. Pulse builds a vector knowledge base of you. every chat retrieves your personal context before hitting the LLM. 4 background agents run silently: extracts commitments, tracks competitors daily via web search, parses reminders, drafts and schedules emails via Gmail. Multi-LLM: Gemini, Llama, Claude. switchable at runtime. Free to use. Open source.

records.name: Creatomap
records.tagline: Who sponsors who on YouTube. 32K creators mapped
records.description: Map the hidden relationships in the creator economy. Creatomap analyzes YouTube videos at scale and extracts every person mentioned and every brand sponsorship. No manual data entry, everything from what creators actually say and show. Search any brand to see their sponsored creators and which competitors fight for the same roster. Search any creator to see their full network. 32K creators. 55K relationships. 2,700 brands. 18 categories. Still growing the dataset. Free, no signup.

records.name: IRO-WMS
records.tagline: Smart Offline Warehouse Management for Modern Businesses
records.description: IRO-WMS is a policy-driven, offline-first warehouse operations platform designed for teams that need continuity, control, and scalable growth. Manage inventory, products, bookings, invoices, receipts, waybills, and transfers in one workspace with role-aware governance. Cloud-enabled capabilities such as backup, sync, and tenant file operations are available with tier-based policy controls while core workflows remain resilient during connectivity interruptions.

records.name: Invisible Arc — Manipulation Analysis
records.tagline: Something's wrong. You just can't name it.
records.description: Emotional manipulations have names. Hidden from your head, but not your gut. Gaslighting. DARVO. Acknowledge-and-Proceed. Each tactic has a structure, a mechanism, and a tell. Most people spend years feeling like something is wrong before they find the language for it. Invisible Architecture is an AI tool that reads your situation and names exactly what's happening — drawn from a 70-tactic proprietary taxonomy, cross-referenced and indexed. Your gut already knew. Now your head can too.

records.name: OS1
records.tagline: self-hosted AI platform - ChatGPT features with better UX
records.description: I've been using various self-hosted AI frontends like Open WebUI for over a year, but no project combines: - ChatGPT-level UX - Open WebUI-level customization and expandability - fully Open Source, whitelabel-friendly - 🖼️ a beautiful, inviting and responsive UI - 👥 workspace features and collaboration so about 5 months ago I started building OS1, and today I'm open sourcing it. the goal is to cover everything you'd expect from LobeHub, ChatGPT and Open WebUI - and then go way further.

records.name: Thumbhook
records.tagline: The YouTube creator toolkit — titles, thumbnails & scripts
records.description: YouTube titles make or break your CTR — but most generators just dump options and leave you guessing. Thumbhook scores every title 1–10 before you publish. Get 8 AI-optimized titles with CTR scores, insights, and style labels in seconds. Free tier needs zero sign-up. Pro ($5/mo) adds AI thumbnails, bulk generate, description generator, hook scripts, and title history.

records.name: Querygen
records.tagline: WhatsApp Analytical Tool
records.description: Querygen is an AI-powered business intelligence platform for messaging apps like WhatsApp. It analyzes group chat conversations and generates automated summaries from messages containing enquiries, team updates, and follow-ups. The platform monitors chats in real time, converts messages into a searchable knowledge base, creates alerts for urgent issues or high-priority leads, labels conversations by topic or priority, syncs data with Google Sheets, and improves visibility across chats.

records.name: CloakPipe
records.tagline: Privacy proxy for LLM & RAG. PII → consistent pseudonyms.
records.description: CloakPipe: Rust privacy proxy for LLM & RAG. Your data never reaches the LLM. Detects PII in <5ms, replaces with consistent pseudonyms (CloakTree), forwards sanitized request, rehydrates response instantly (SSE works). Single Rust binary. <5ms overhead. AES-256 vault (BYOK). No raw PII stored. Install: cargo install cloakpipe-cli && cloakpipe init && cloakpipe start MIT open source. Free self-host. GitHub: https://github.com/rohansx/cloakpipe Site: https://cloakpipe.co

records.name: LiveWall
records.tagline: Share and collect photos and videos with a QR code
records.description: LiveWall lets you share with your guests at events, and collect photos and videos from your guests with a QR code. For weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, parties, corporate events and more. Show live slideshows as content comes. Like vinyl for social media. Privacy first service.

records.name: FileFind — Ask Anything About Your Files
records.tagline: AI file search that never leaves your machine
records.description: FileFind is a local-first AI agent that lets you search your files using natural language. Instead of remembering filenames or digging through folders, just ask — "which resume is best for a data science role?" or "what contracts mention payment terms?" and FileFind reads, reasons, and finds exactly what you need. Everything runs 100% on your machine. No cloud, no API keys, no data ever sent anywhere. Your files stay yours. Built with Ollama + ChromaDB + Tauri.

records.name: Cliza
records.tagline: Onchain LLM game where players battle for district control
records.description: Cliza is a Night City strategy game on Base where agents launch AgentCoins, battle for district control, and build their labs.

records.name: Nuri.com Bitcoin Passkey Wallet & Bank
records.tagline: Passkey Bitcoin & Stablecoin Wallet with Onchain VISA & Bank
records.description: Own Bitcoin Easy. Backup and Recovery with Passkeys. Get Your Free Bitcoin Credit Card. A Free European IBAN linked to your wallet. Always keep 100% control over your money onchain. Be Your Own Bank - not your keys, not your coins. Live in the EU / EEA in 32 countries.

records.name: Entity
records.tagline: Collaborative Decision Ledger for Startups
records.description: Entity is a reasoning-first AI platform for teams to take high stake decisions effortlessly

records.name: AI Tools Scout
records.tagline: 400+ AI tools, curated and scored. Build your stack.
records.description: AI Tools Scout is a nightly-updated directory of 400+ AI tools across 18 categories. Search by use case, compare tools, save collections, and share your stack. Free to browse. Pro at $7/month. 10% of subs go to charity.

records.name: TaskSwappers
records.tagline: Trade Your Skills, Gain New Ones No Money Needed.
records.description: Task Swappers, a free platform to swap skills instead of paying. 🎓🤝 Teach what you know, learn what you don’t! From coding for cooking to design for dance lessons, trade talents directly with others. No fees, just community. Join the movement! #SwapSkillsNotBills #TaskSwappers

records.name: SendView: Mail Merge Simplified
records.tagline: From spreadsheet to personalized emails in less than 5 min.
records.description: Existing mail merge tools are clunky, complicated, expensive, or all three. SendView solves this by making it dead simple to go from a spreadsheet or Airtable view to personalized, templated emails in less than five minutes. After setting up an Airtable token or linking a Google account, just write your template, past the link to your sheet or view, connect the fields, and send through your own accounts.

records.name: TrabahoHub
records.tagline: Post jobs for free — built for startups and small businesses
records.description: TrabahoHub is a free job posting platform built for startups, recruiters, and small businesses. Many job boards charge expensive fees just to post a single job listing. This can be difficult for startups or small companies that need to hire but have limited budgets. TrabahoHub removes that barrier by allowing employers to post job opportunities completely free. Our goal is simple: make hiring accessible and affordable for everyone.

records.name: UPtrim
records.tagline: Your AI forgets you. UPtrim fixes that. Memory that lasts.
records.description: Your AI forgets everything the moment you close the chat. Your name, your preferences, your projects — gone. UPtrim sits between your app and your model and gives it a permanent memory. Every conversation picks up where the last one left off. Free on GitHub — Mac, Linux, Windows.

records.name: Channel Surfer
records.tagline: Turn your YouTube subscriptions into a retro cable TV guide
records.description: Remember flipping through the TV guide? Channel Surfer turns your YouTube subscriptions into a retro cable TV experience. Import your channels, tune in, and let it play.

records.name: Web ADB by Pixel-AI
records.tagline: Run ADB commands directly from your browser
records.description: Managing Android devices usually means bulky SDKs and driver headaches. Web ADB changes that. Using the WebUSB API, it provides a full ADB terminal, file explorer, and app installer right in your browser. No installation, no setup—just plug and play. ⚡️ Interactive Shell 📦 Drag-and-drop APK Sideloading 📂 Remote File Management 📸 Instant Screen Capture 💻 Works on Windows, Mac, Linux, and Chromebook.

records.name: EggStage Timer
records.tagline: Make a perfect boiled egg
records.description: Beautiful animated egg timer with 3 stages: Soft, Medium, and Hard boiled. Free Android app.

records.name: Instacall AI
records.tagline: Your AI receptionist that never misses a call
records.description: Every missed call is lost revenue. Instacall AI is a 24/7 AI voice receptionist that answers calls, books appointments, and notifies your team instantly. No hardware. No training. We provide the phone number you're live in minutes. Built for healthcare clinics in Mexico, expanding globally. At our price point, we pay for ourselves with one saved call per day.

records.name: Tranzmit AI
records.tagline: AI Product Managers that intercept churn before users leave
records.description: AI PMs which intercept churn and create Jira tickets to reduce it. Our agents sit on top of cancellation buttons, and for each user who cancels, we analyse their behavioural data from 6+ sources, and do human PM-level 1:1 voice interventions to surface "root" causes and resurrect them. This helps us automatically create actionable Jira tickets for your team to fix and retain users.

records.name: Helio-PM
records.tagline: Smarter Teams,Fewer Surprises.
records.description: Web and IOS released with Android - In process Features: • Autonomous AI project monitoring with health scores • Ask AI — query your project data in plain English • Smart workload balancing across your team • Budget intelligence with live forecasting • Daily AI digest delivered every morning • Voice commands for hands-free task management • Integrations: Slack, Google Calendar, GitHub

records.name: Roadside Advocate App
records.tagline: App giving legal info to drivers interacting with police
records.description: Know your rights during traffic stops. Record, learn, and protect yourself. This app makes it easy to access information regarding your legal rights, cases related to your specific traffic stop, the ability to record with audio directly from this app, a panic button that will immediately and quietly dial your preloaded emergency contact (an attorney or relative). It is designed to make the user more confident when dealing with police during a stop.

records.name: ZeroKey
records.tagline: Open-source, burn-after-reading encrypted vault.
records.description: Share sensitive payloads securely. ZeroKey uses client-side AES-256-GCM encryption. Keys never touch the server. The millisecond a payload is decrypted locally, it is permanently hard-deleted from the database. Zero data retention.

records.name: Robot Trust Hub
records.tagline: The open trust protocol for AI-friendly websites
records.description: Robot Trust Hub is the open protocol for AI-friendly websites. Any site can self-publish a robots-trust.json certificate. Get verified status and join the trusted registry.

records.name: Stage Zero
records.tagline: Agent workflows for medtech, from BCIs to surgical robots
records.description: Stage Zero is building A.I. workflows for MedTech companies, helping them discover and launch the next market leading device / treatment faster. We analyze billions of data points across literature, FDA, clinical trials, global patents, and more, to help teams make smarter and faster decisions in new products and unmet needs.

records.name: Actionable — Turn Learning Into Action
records.tagline: Turn the books you read into daily action plans.
records.description: Most of us suffer from the knowledge-action gap. We read dozens of books, but struggle to implement the lessons. Actionable solves this by turning your favorite books into personalized 21-day action plans. Using behavioral psychology and AI, we break down complex concepts into daily micro-tasks tailored to your specific goals and constraints. Progress through three distinct learning cycles to ensure the knowledge actually sticks. Start transforming your life, one small action at a time.

records.name: Fort
records.tagline: Fort tracks strength for people who care about longevity.
records.description: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.
